annotations.title: Edit what was read from a product

description: Changes a product’s name, kind, selling points (up to 5 short lines printed on images), facts (by key from list_products; an empty value removes one) or scene. Only the fields given change; later image sets use them. Free. Returns the product. Example: {"product_id": "…", "features": ["Set of 3", "Leak-proof lids"]}

category.description: What kind of product it is, e.g. "kitchen storage"

facts.description: Fact values by key; an empty value removes the fact

features.description: Selling points, replacing the current ones

name: edit_product
